spec_case: issue #778 step 7, H1 (all_proxy/ALL_PROXY is the fallback for an http URL, lowercase winning over uppercase)
description: Neither `http_proxy` nor `https_proxy` is set; `ALL_PROXY` points at a closed port and `all_proxy` at the mock server. Success here is only possible if the fallback applies at all, and if the lowercase form wins over the uppercase one when both are set.
